definitions: To deviate from established rules of conduct or etiquette, especially in diplomatic or formal settings.
To disregard conventional procedures or expected behavior.
examples: The ambassador decided to break protocol by directly addressing the crowd.
Her decision to wear jeans to the formal dinner was seen as breaking protocol.
He had to break protocol to get the urgent message through.
Breaking protocol can sometimes lead to innovative solutions.
They were warned not to break protocol during the royal visit.
